history.title: Missile strike at King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh
history.text: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to every Saudi airport except Medina. Further attacks, disruption and cancellations are described as very likely. Later wording extends all-but-essential advice to the rest of the country.

history.title: New guidance on Houthi missile and drone risk
history.text: No travel within 10km of the Yemen border, all but essential travel 10 to 80km from it. Advice on sheltering during an attack. Insurance cover may be affected.

history.title: Eastern Province and Riyadh Province added
history.text: All but essential travel advised against in both provinces, with continued missile and drone attacks reported.

history.title: Stay-inside advice
history.text: British nationals told to stay inside and take extra care because of missile and drone activity in the region.

history.title: Heightened regional tension warning
history.text: Against all travel to parts of the country (Yemen border). Travellers told to sign up for alerts and know where to shelter.

countries.name: United States
countries.headline: Level 3: Reconsider Travel
countries.detail: Latest: US Embassy security alert dated 17 Nov 2026, countrywide: take extreme caution at Saudi airports. Advisory stays Level 3; the Yemen border region is Level 4: Do not travel.

history.title: US Embassy security alert (dated 17 Nov 2026), countrywide
history.text: The US Mission to Saudi Arabia asks travellers to take extreme caution at Saudi airports after missile and drone attacks. US government staff need special approval to use any airport in the country. The travel advisory stays at Level 3. Source: sa.usembassy.gov

history.title: Saudi Arabia - Level 3: Reconsider Travel
history.text: Detected automatically from travel.state.gov. Open the official page for the full advisory.

history.title: Level 3 reissued with detention and exit-ban warnings
history.text: Americans told not to photograph or share missile and drone interception or impact sites, after detentions. Yemen border stays Level 4.

history.label: Mid Sep 2026
history.title: Level 3 reissued, reported 16 Sep
history.text: Cites Iranian drone and missile targeting of American interests, armed conflict, terrorism, exit bans and local laws.

history.title: Family members may rejoin US government staff
history.text: Eased the earlier departure order for embassy and consulate families.

history.title: Level unchanged, summary updated
history.text: Government staff barred from non-essential travel to Qatif. Yemen border Level 4 for terrorism.

history.title: Raised from Level 2 to Level 3
history.text: Non-emergency US government staff authorised to leave Saudi Arabia.

history.text: Houthi attacks since early September across Riyadh, Asir, Jazan, Medina, Mecca, Najran and the Eastern Province. Riyadh airport is a regular target and flights at other airports are irregular.

countries.name: Russia
countries.headline: Advised against tourist trips
countries.detail: The Foreign Ministry advised Russians not to travel to Saudi Arabia for tourism until active fighting ends and flights and airports return to normal. This is the latest statement I could confirm. The embassy's page is watched for changes, but check the official site before quoting it.

history.title: Foreign Ministry urges no tourist trips
history.text: Russians were urged to refrain from tourist trips to the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman and Saudi Arabia until active fighting ends and flights and airports return to normal.

countries.name: China
countries.authority: Embassy of China in Saudi Arabia
countries.headline: Avoid domestic air travel in Saudi Arabia for now
countries.detail: The embassy urged citizens to limit non-essential travel and stay away from airports, oil facilities and military sites. This is the latest notice I could confirm. Check the embassy site before quoting it.

history.title: Embassy urges avoiding domestic flights
history.text: Citizens were urged to avoid domestic air travel in Saudi Arabia after repeated attacks on airports and key infrastructure.

countries.name: India
countries.headline: Check flights before you travel
countries.detail: The embassy has issued advisories on disruption at Saudi airports and asks Indians to check flight availability before travel. This is the latest advisory I could confirm. Flight schedules change quickly, so check the embassy site before quoting it.

history.title: Advisory on airport disruption
history.text: Indians planning travel to Saudi Arabia, including for Umrah, were told to take account of ongoing disruption at Saudi airports and possible cancellations.
